title: Cursor
description: Cursor's CLI (cursor-agent) as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on your own cursor-agent over ACP with Tomrade's tools, a ticket can also go to cursor-agent in a terminal, which reaches Tomrade through its own connection in ~/.cursor/mcp.json, and its sign-in answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Connecting Cursor adds a tomrade server to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (your other servers are kept), and a background call runs in a folder of its own under the temporary directory.
why.exec: Runs your own `cursor-agent` command: `cursor-agent acp` for conversations and tickets, `cursor-agent status` to see whether it is signed in, and `cursor-agent -p` in ask mode for background calls.
